summary: Thin forwarding helper. Receives two 64-bit values a1 and a2 via x87 ST registers, decomposes each into its low/high 32-bit halves, and forwards all four dwords to sub_588212. Returns sub_588212's result directly. No local state is touched.

operations.description: Decompose a2 into its low dword and high dword (HIDWORD(a2)), and a1 into its low dword and high dword (HIDWORD(a1)).
Call sub_588212 with the four halves in order (a2 low, a2 high, a1 low, a1 high).
Return the result of sub_588212 in EAX.

unresolved: Meaning of the two 64-bit inputs a1/a2. Callers include random, noise, audio-pitch and wheel-update paths, suggesting a randomness or transform entry point, but sub_588212's semantics are unconfirmed here.
Purpose of widening two 64-bit values into four 32-bit parameters for sub_588212 (register-pair argument marshalling).
